title: Foundation Movement Recording Roadmap
purpose: Give a trainer a bounded gym-session capture plan. MoveNet recordings provide PocketPT's 2D perception evidence; animation/FBX references later provide missing depth, pelvis/root mechanics and 3D bone rotation evidence.

statusMeaning.CAPTURED: At least one local MoveNet recording exists for the task's primary Lego block. This means 2D evidence was collected; it does not mean the block is validated or ready.
statusMeaning.NEEDS_CAPTURE: No local MoveNet evidence has been saved yet for the task's primary Lego block.

captureRules: Keep the full body, including both feet and both hands, visible whenever the movement allows it.
Use controlled repetitions before fast repetitions so phase changes are easy to study.
Front view is best for left/right symmetry and lateral travel; side view is best for squat depth, hinge, root descent and floor transitions.
Export important JSON evidence after the session. V1 browser-local evidence is intentionally bounded and is not the permanent reviewed motion library.
A captured task supplies 2D evidence only. Canonical Lego status still requires later study/review, and 3D rotation questions require animation/FBX or another 3D source.

foundationSession.label: Foundation 8
foundationSession.description: Eight high-value recordings that cover the greatest number of reusable movement blocks without requiring a long gym session.

tasks.label: Standing Baseline
tasks.repetitions: Hold a relaxed athletic stance for about 3 seconds, then make one small weight shift left and right.

tasks.label: Slow Bodyweight Squat
tasks.repetitions: Perform 3 slow squats. Pause briefly at the bottom of each rep.

tasks.label: Forward Lunge — Both Sides
tasks.repetitions: Perform 2 controlled forward lunges with the left leg and 2 with the right leg.

tasks.label: Vertical Jump + Landing
tasks.repetitions: Perform 3 controlled vertical jumps. Reset fully between jumps and finish each landing before the next takeoff.

tasks.label: Stand → Ground / Plank Entry
tasks.repetitions: Perform 2 to 3 controlled stand-to-plank walkouts. Move slowly enough that hands-down, weight-transfer and plank-acquire phases are visible.
tasks.recordingLabel: foundation stand to ground plank entry

tasks.label: Ground / Plank → Stand
tasks.repetitions: From plank, perform 2 to 3 controlled walk-ins back to standing. Finish completely upright before repeating.

tasks.label: Slow Push-Up Cycle
tasks.repetitions: Perform 3 slow push-ups. Pause briefly at the bottom and lock out clearly at the top.

tasks.label: Alternating Knee Drive / Mountain Climber
tasks.repetitions: From plank, perform 4 controlled knee drives per side. Keep the first set slow and symmetrical.
